name: omnilab/gaia
description: Omnilab Gaia: a source of ESA's Gaia DR3 by its source_id or designation (Gaia DR3 4472832130942575872) - its position at epoch J2016.0, parallax, proper motion and RUWE, its G, BP, RP and RVS magnitudes, radial velocity and line broadening, its astrophysical parameters (GSP-Phot temperature, gravity, metallicity, distance, extinction; FLAME radius, mass, luminosity, age; Apsis spectral type), its class probabilities and Hipparcos number - and the sources of a cone on the sky, through the ESA Gaia Archive's TAP service in ADQL, no key needed.
